market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to open lower on Middle East risk and Wall Street weakness. Oil-driven energy outperformance offsets broad risk-off. Qantas strike vote and property data add volatility. RBA rate expectations rising create headwind for growth and property. Expect 1-2% index pullback in near term.
market_outlook.long_term: Critical minerals and healthcare offer structural growth. Property correction may extend 6-12 months post-budget tax changes. Geopolitical oil premium supports energy. AI capex moderation could hit tech. RBA likely to hold or hike, keeping a lid on rate-sensitive sectors. ASX 200 to trade in a range pending rate path clarity.
